info.title: Urja Meter API
info.description: A clean, read-only API over the Urja Meter Ops portal: smart meters, where they sit in the network, and their readings.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of a meter id or serial number, any case.

parameters.name: zone
parameters.description: Exact zone code. Codes repeat across branches; see /hierarchy.

parameters.name: circle
parameters.description: Exact circle code. Codes repeat across branches; see /hierarchy.

parameters.name: division
parameters.description: Exact division code. Codes repeat across branches; see /hierarchy.

parameters.name: subdivision
parameters.description: Exact subdivision code. Codes repeat across branches; see /hierarchy.

parameters.name: substation
parameters.description: Exact substation code. Codes repeat across branches; see /hierarchy.

parameters.name: feeder
parameters.description: Exact feeder code. Codes repeat across branches; see /hierarchy.

parameters.name: transformer
parameters.description: Exact transformer code. Codes repeat across branches; see /hierarchy.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Meters under one node of the tree, by its path from /hierarchy. Unlike codes, paths are unique.

parameters.name: near
parameters.description: lat,lng. Keeps meters within radiusKm and sorts them nearest first.

syncedAt.description: When the data was last copied from the portal.

hierarchy.description: Where the meter sits in the network, from zone down to its distribution transformer.

distanceKm.description: Only present when near is given.

get.summary: Energy readings for one meter, oldest first
get.description: Readings are fetched from the portal on demand and cached for five minutes. If the portal fails, the last good readings are served; check fetchedAt.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start, inclusive. A bare date means 00:00 IST that day.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End, inclusive. A bare date includes that whole IST day.

fetchedAt.description: When these readings were fetched from the portal.

totalKwhUsed.description: Sum of kwhUsed over the returned readings.

duplicatesDropped.description: Rows the portal sent twice for the same time. We keep the most complete one.

timestamp.description: India Standard Time (+05:30). The portal sends DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm with no time zone.

kwhCumulative.description: Active energy register in kWh. It only goes up. Null when the portal sent it blank.

kvahCumulative.description: Apparent energy register in kVAh. It only goes up. Null when the portal sent it blank.

voltageR.description: R-phase voltage in volts. Null when the portal sent it blank.

kwhUsed.description: kWh used since the previous reading that had a kWh value. Null for the first reading, when this one has no kWh value, and if the register went backwards.
